dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 26, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Rays Outlast Guardians in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**

In a low-scoring affair, the Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen pitching a gem. Rasmussen went 7 strong innings, striking out 9, walking 1 and allowing just 1 hit. Cedric Mullins' bunt single in the 7th inning plated the game's only run, scoring Chandler Simpson. Bryan Baker earned the save for the Rays.

**Nationals Come from Behind to Down Diamondbacks 10-7**

The Washington Nationals overcame a 7-4 deficit to defeat the Arizona Diamondbacks 10-7. CJ Abrams led the Nationals with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs, while Ketel Marte had a big day for the Diamondbacks with 2 hits and 2 RBIs. Riley Cornelio earned the win in relief.

**Pirates Edge Cubs 8-7 in Extra Innings**

The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Chicago Cubs 8-7 in an extra-inning thriller. Ryan O'Hearn hit a solo home run for the Cubs, while Seiya Suzuki also went deep for the Cubs. Braxton Ashcraft earned the win for the Pirates.

**Red Sox Shut Down Blue Jays 6-1**

The Boston Red Sox dominated the Toronto Blue Jays 6-1 behind the strong pitching of Ranger Suarez, who struck out 6 in 4 innings. Jarren Duran had 3 hits for the Red Sox.

**Braves Hold Off Orioles 3-2**

The Atlanta Braves edged out the Baltimore Orioles 3-2 behind the strong pitching of Reynaldo López, who struck out 6 in 5.2 innings. Pete Alonso hit a solo home run for the Braves.

**Royals Pull Off Upset 5-4 Over Tigers**

The Kansas City Royals pulled off a stunning upset over the Detroit Tigers 5-4. Michael Massey hit a solo home run for the Royals.

**Mets Cruise to 8-3 Victory Over Dodgers**

The New York Mets cruised to an 8-3 victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers behind the strong pitching of Emmet Sheehan, who struck out 5 in 5 innings. Munetaka Murakami had a big day for the Astros with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs.

**Padres Edge Marlins 5-3**

The San Diego Padres edged out the Miami Marlins 5-3 behind the strong pitching of Janson Junk, who struck out 6 in 4.2 innings. Manny Machado hit a solo home run for the Padres.

**Twins Rally to Beat Athletics 11-8**

The Minnesota Twins came from behind to defeat the Oakland Athletics 11-8 behind the strong pitching of Connor Prielipp, who struck out 5 in 5.2 innings. Munetaka Murakami had a big day for the Astros with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs.

**White Sox Blow Out Astros 12-3**

The Chicago White Sox dominated the Houston Astros 12-3 behind the strong pitching of Grant Taylor, who struck out 2 in 1 inning. Munetaka Murakami had a big day for the Astros with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs.

**Brewers Cruise to 11-2 Victory Over Rockies**

The Milwaukee Brewers cruised to an 11-2 victory over the Colorado Rockies behind the strong pitching of Jacob Misiorowski, who struck out 12 in 5 innings. Andrew Vaughn hit a solo home run for the Rockies.

**Reds Edge Cardinals 5-3**

The Cincinnati Reds edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 5-3 behind the strong pitching of Kyle Leahy, who struck out 9 in 6 innings. Elly De La Cruz hit a solo home run for the Reds.

**Mariners Come from Behind to Beat Rangers 6-4**

The Seattle Mariners came from behind to defeat the Texas Rangers 6-4 behind the strong pitching of Andrés Muñoz, who struck out 3 in 1 inning. Dominic Canzone hit a solo home run for the Mariners.

**Angels Edge Giants 4-3**

The Los Angeles Angels edged out the San Francisco Giants 4-3 behind the strong pitching of José Soriano, who struck out 5 in 5 innings. Jorge Soler hit a solo home run for the Angels.

**Phillies Cruise to 11-4 Victory Over Yankees**

The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the New York Yankees 11-4 behind the strong pitching of Cristopher Sánchez, who struck out 5 in 2 innings. Bryson Stott hit a solo home run for the Phillies.
